rationale: Calculated short-circuit currents at three fault locations by summing source, transformer, and feeder impedances. Maximum 3-phase fault of 9.32 kA occurs at near-bus location. Minimum 2-phase fault of 1.52 kA occurs at remote end. Selected 12.5 kA breaker as smallest standard rating exceeding 9.32 × 1.1 = 10.25 kA requirement. Relay pickup of 600 A satisfies load margin constraint (≥450 A) and fault sensitivity constraint (≤760 A).
